contadores.description: Bank reconciliation app: match bank statement Excel with accounting Excel by date, amount and concept; outputs Excel with differences (matched, possible, unmatched) in outputs/.

loginOauth.title: Login con OAuth

awInternetSales.title: AW Internet Sales
awInternetSales.description: Microsoft Analysis Services tabular model for internet sales metrics, optimized for Business Intelligence and data analysis.

tarjetaCredito.title: Proyecto Tarjeta de Credito
tarjetaCredito.description: Full-stack credit card management with full CRUD: Angular 20 (responsive, validations, notifications) and .NET 8 REST API with Entity Framework, SQL Server, Swagger, CORS.

backendJava.title: Proyecto backend Java
backendJava.description: REST API for supermarket management (products, branches, sales) with Spring Boot 4 and Java 25, JPA/Hibernate, MySQL, repository and controller tests, Docker support.

taskFlowApi.title: Task-Flow API
taskFlowApi.description: REST API for task management with Spring Boot 4 and Java 25, PostgreSQL, JWT auth, Swagger, pagination and filters, Testcontainers integration tests, Docker.

portfolioMobile.title: Portafolio mobile
portfolioMobile.description: Cross-platform mobile portfolio with React Native and Expo: dark mode, multi-language, carousel navigation, local storage, Context API.

pronafe.title: Proyecto Pronafe
pronafe.description: Educational web system (PRONAFE) with Laravel 12 and React 19 via Inertia.js: institutes, periods, roles (Admin, Supervisor, Instituto), auth, bulk emails, Excel export, API.

windowsForm.title: Proyecto Windows Form
windowsForm.description: Desktop system for attendance and staff management with .NET Framework and Windows Forms: CRUD for employees and positions, check-in/out, automatic hours calculation.

urlShortener.title: URL Shortener
urlShortener.description: Minimal .NET API to shorten URLs, custom slugs, 302 redirect, validations, bilingual (ES/EN) OpenAPI and Scalar docs, ready to scale with PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT.

bocato.title: Bocato Pasteleria
bocato.description: Modern pastry website with Angular 20: i18n (ES/EN), dark mode, animations, responsive design, state with Signals, preferences in localStorage.
